method: All removed original source triangles, both sourceF64 and importF32. Camera-space near-plane polygon clipping before perspective divide; exact binary-rational inclusive convex polygon/pixel rectangle SAT after CPU projection. Whole pixel square plus2px each edge. No depth/occlusion/backface/far pruning.
limitations: CPU basis from actual recorded pose/target does not reproduce Blender quaternion/Euler/matrix, GPU jitter/rounding, interpolation or primitive ownership.
Perspective36mm factory horizontal square sensor follows the hash-pinned retained analytic projection convention; sensor width is not serialized in native comparison.
2px padding is conservative diagnostic scope; it changes no native/guard tolerance and is not a formal bound on all GPU arithmetic.
Every intersecting removed original face maps to its entire kept removal site, including occluded geometry. No model mutation, rerender, ray cast, validation or publication.
